notes.title: UI Scaling Hotfix: Resolving Screen Resolution and Button Placement Issues
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed critical UI scaling bug causing buttons and interface elements to extend beyond screen boundaries
[*] Restored proper UI visibility and accessibility across different screen resolutions
[*] Ensured settings menu remains fully navigable and adjustable
[/list]

We strongly recommend this update for anyone who experienced problems with UI scaling. If you're still having issues after the update, please reach out and let us know. We appreciate all of your feedback and apologize for any inconvenience you may have experienced!

notes.title: Game Balance Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Crypto Miner OS Rework[/h2]
The Bitcoin-earning mechanism has been refined. Instead of gaining 1 Bitcoin per move, players now earn double Bitcoin from Bitcoin files. However, this comes with increased risk: getting these files will now trigger 1.5x the System Alert. This change encourages more strategic file picking, making suppression files more valuable than ever. Players can get rich faster, but must be more cautious.

[h2]Middle Man OS Enhancements[/h2]
The Middle Man OS now provides gateway directions across the network. Unlike the 'scan' side command, Middle Man passive ability is always active and doesn't incur any System Alert cost. The ability to restore System Alert when visiting the home node remains unchanged.

[h2]Suppression Command Balancing[/h2]
The 'suppress' side command has been adjusted to prevent potential exploit strategies. While the initial execution cost remains 10 Bitcoins, the cost will now incrementally increase with each use within the same network. Connecting through a gateway will reset the cost to its original value.

[h2]Cloak Command Modification[/h2]
The 'cloak' command no longer prevents System Alerts triggered by self-re-execution or other side commands, including the 'sweep' command from Hacky OS Beta.

[h2]Add Requested Command Alias[/h2]
In response to player feedback, we've added and corrected the 'cd ..' command (with a space) as alternative command to 'back', which was previously mistakenly implemented as 'cd..' (without a space).

These changes aim to create a more balanced and strategic gameplay and more pleasure experience. Thank you for all of your feedback. Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Balance Update: "Suppress" Side Command Adjustment
notes.notes: We've made changes to the "suppress" side command since it was proving too powerful in gameplay. The command now reduces your System Alert level by half rather than completely removing it, though it still costs 10 Bitcoins to use. We've also fixed the incorrect descriptions and log messages that were appearing across all language versions.

notes.title: Typing with pleasure update
notes.notes:
INITIATING SYSTEM UPDATE v1.0.0.2
EXECUTING PROTOCOL: ENHANCEMENT

ATTENTION OPERATIVES:

We've intercepted vital intel from our network of shadow agents and systematically eliminated multiple security vulnerabilities. Your field reports have been instrumental in optimizing our systems. The following upgrades have been deployed to strengthen our digital arsenal.

[h3]Enhanced Node Name Generation[/h3]
- Implemented real-world word generation for node names, making commands more intuitive to type
- Added toggle option in settings to switch between new and classic generation methods
- Optimized classic random letter generation to reduce uncomfortable key combinations (q, a, x, w, z)
- Changes take effect on new levels after updating settings

[h3]Customizable Hack Speed[/h3]
- Introduced hack speed multiplier in settings
- Perfect for players who enjoy rapid-fire keyboard input
Note: Must be configured before starting a new game session

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
- CHIP DATA now saves to wallet on manual disconnection
- Added comprehensive tutorial for the rotation mini-game (skipable)
- Enhanced overall game accessibility for international players

[h3]Bugs Fixed[/h3]
- Fixed an issue on EXPLORERIT able to jump to blank node.
- Fixed an issue on name generation interfered with user's command-line.
